visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A woman with voluminous curly black hair and red-framed glasses sits behind a wooden desk, wearing a bright yellow collared shirt under a black community leader vest. She holds a professional microphone close to her mouth against a studio background with a monitor. (2) She begins speaking with animated facial expressions, including slight smiles and eyebrow movements, while looking directly into the camera. Yellow and white subtitles appear at the bottom of the frame to capture her speech. (3) Large stylized text in yellow and blue flashes across the screen identifying her as 'Chief Li Shufen' while she continues her humorous announcement, maintaining steady eye contact and casual hand gestures. (4) The scene remains static in terms of framing, focusing on her upper body and the microphone. She occasionally glances down or to the side for comedic timing before delivering her next line with a smirk. (5) At the conclusion of her speech, she lowers the microphone to the desk, her posture relaxes, and her expression shifts from the 'official' broadcast persona to a casual, slightly bored demeanor as she looks away.

The female voice adopts a professional yet exaggerated community broadcast tone. There are noticeable shifts in pitch for emphasis, particularly when discussing humorous topics like oversized rats. (4) The BGM remains at a steady volume beneath the narration, providing a comedic underscore. The video relies on the contrast between the formal broadcast tone and the nonsensical content.
